summary_zh: Strategy 連續五週未買 bitcoin，賣出 5.445 億美元 MSTR，美元儲備升至 37.5 億美元。

content: STORJ dropped 19% to $0.06 after Storj Labs filed voluntary Chapter 11 on July 26 to resolve legacy liabilities.

content: The largest bank in South Korea plans to launch a blockchain-based cross-border corporate payments service next month, according to Yonhap.

title: The Funding: Are crypto vaults funds and curators fund managers?
content: The SEC's Hester Peirce says some of them may be — which could mean registration. Here's what that means, and what comes next.

title: Triple-A hot wallet losses climb to $11.8 million as new deposits keep being swept: report
content: Triple-A said it is investigating and that customer funds are not affected, though it has not fully addressed the incident publicly.

content: The banking-as-a-service provider will power X Money’s peer-to-peer payments, FDIC-insured accounts and Visa debit cards as the platform expands its financial services.

title: Tether’s XAUt gold token receives Shariah certification to expand Islamic finance access

title: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business
content: The deal brings wallet technology to Payward’s enterprise platform, potentially reducing the number of infrastructure providers businesses need to integrate with.

summary_zh: Bitcoin跟隨美股上漲，因美伊停火消息帶動風險資產反彈。

title: Hong Kong crypto giant HashKey merges regional exchange into one

summary_zh: Bitcoin交易員將面對美國通膨數據與美伊衝突等波動催化劑。

title: USDC發行商Circle將收購近1,000項IBM區塊鏈專利

title: 巴西警方破獲與加密貨幣相關的跨國毒品洗錢案

summary_zh: Polymarket與Myriad預測7月Fed升息機率升至27%，24小時內大漲。
